The screen is built at `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

- A combobox-style search input (with mock data for 6 benefits inline) shows live, filtered suggestions as you type; ArrowUp/Down moves through them, Enter selects the highlighted one (or searches the raw text if none is highlighted), and Escape closes the list.
- Selecting a suggestion (or pressing Enter) shows results as cards with name, category, one-line description, and an "Eligible"/"Not eligible" badge.
- If nothing matches, a dedicated no-results state is shown instead of the grid.
- CSS uses logical properties (for RTL) and Strata token variables with sensible fallbacks, since `@strata/react`/`@strata/tokens` aren't installed in this sandbox to inspect their exact API — I avoided importing unverified components from `@strata/react` and stuck to plain semantic HTML/ARIA to keep it robust across brands/themes.

I couldn't run or visually verify the app per the instructions, so please review it in the browser across the brand/scheme/locale variants when you get a chance.
